        cost += matrix[route[-1]][depot]
        return cost

        s = 0

        return True

            b = route[i + 1]

                d = route[j + 1]
                delta = (matrix[a][c] + matrix[b][d]) - (matrix[a][b] + matrix[c][d])
                if delta < -1e-9:
                    best_i, best_j = i, j
                    best_delta = delta
                    break

        route[i + 1 : j + 1] = reversed(route[i + 1 : j + 1])
